name: Salesforce
one_liner: Salesforce offers a comprehensive REST API that can be accessed via OAuth 2.0 and is available to all orgs.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization.
access_notes: Create a connected app in your org to obtain OAuth credentials.

extras.rate_limits: Daily API Request Limit (e.g., 100,000 calls per 24‑hour period) and a soft limit that can be exceeded with a 403 error; also a /limits endpoint and Limits Info header.

evidence.snippet: OAuth is an open protocol that authorizes a client application to access data from a protected resource through the exchange of tokens.
You can use OAuth authorization to approve a client application’s access to your org’s protected resources.
REST API is one of several web interfaces that you can use to access your Salesforce data without using the Salesforce user interface.
REST API uses RESTful architecture to provide a straightforward and consistent interface.
REST API Developer Guide | Salesforce Developers
REST API Developer Guide | Salesforce Developers
